item.tib: tshe dbang dpal bo bdun pa las ser ba bsrung ba'i gdam pa
item.coloph: dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskur (bskul) ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod pa gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal la brten nas/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgrod par shog mkha' 'gro rigs lnga yi (yis) rnam 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la rgyud (brgyud) pa dge legs 'phel//
